newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES MARCH 20.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES MARCH 20.

text.p: Here are the main headlines reported on Latvia's state radio in the early afternon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis concludes a three-day visit to Denmark and meets MPs, political parties and expatriates.
- Parliament will decide on stripping MP Valdis Krisbergs of his parliamentary immunity. The prosecutors office wants to charge Krisbergs with large-scale fraud.
- Oil company Statoil is worried about the oil terminal construction agreement still not signed by Riga city council.
- Latvian and Russian border delimitation talks continue in Riga today and tomorrow.
